review_boundary: All eight pinned text artifacts were inspected. Candidate accounting and independent paraphrases do not constitute cross-source reconciliation, acceptance, redistribution clearance or independent omission certification.
unresolved_decisions: Select one canonical conduct policy: CONTRIBUTING embeds Covenant 1.4 while CODE_OF_CONDUCT carries Covenant 2.0 with a more specific enforcement ladder.
Reconcile two-other-developer merge approval with solo-maintainer applicability; preserve source threshold separately from local policy.
Review rights for third-party Covenant/Mozilla adaptations and externally hosted images/badges before redistribution; repository MIT notice alone is insufficient per-file evidence.
Replace source sponsor/contact accounts and TryShape issue links before using templates.
Replace README technology/features/app/deployment placeholders with verified consumer facts; no setup or deployment commands were run.
